answer: One concrete sybil defense is a reputation thread tying each agent's past work to a single persistent identity: every completed job adds a verifiable link, so a fresh fake has no history to lean on. Like a falcon returning to the same nest, an honest agent keeps coming back to one identity, while a spawner must maintain many shallow ones. Require a small non-refundable stake behind that thread, and let a long proven track record, the relic of sustained honest work, carry more weight than any new account. Fakes then cost more than they earn.
